description:
A sharper, darker look for Mineclonia's own inventory screens, plus automatic sorting. Inspired by i3, but keeps Mineclonia's vanilla feel.

A sharper, darker look for Mineclonia's own inventory screens, plus automatic
sorting. Inspired by i3, but keeps Mineclonia's vanilla feel.

- **Dark theme** for the survival inventory, chests and furnaces.
- **Auto-sort** with one switch per player, covering your inventory and every
  chest and container. Your hotbar is never touched.
- **Tidier layout:** Advancements, Help and Player settings sit beside the
  player model, and the Recipe book sits beside Fill Craft Grid.
- **Furnaces stay hands-on:** output is never auto-collected, because taking
  out what you smelted is part of the fun.

## Compatibility
Made for Mineclonia (Luanti 5.10 or newer). Works alongside Mineclonia's own
furnace XP, advancements and comparators.

## How this was made
Designed, tested and maintained by Legacy_Tall_Grass. The code and textures
were made with AI assistance (Claude); the textures were drawn from scratch
for this mod, and no Mineclonia art is included. Everything was tested in real
worlds. Bug reports are welcome.

## Credits
Built to complement Mineclonia, with thanks to the Mineclonia and Luanti
developers.
